semiconductor_relevance: Medium — LINTEC provides equipment and materials specifically designed for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: LINTEC Advanced Technologies (Taiwan) Inc. is a manufacturer specializing in pressure-sensitive adhesive materials and related equipment for the semiconductor industry. Their product offerings include adhesive tapes and label materials, as well as equipment such as label-printing and packaging machines tailored for semiconductor applications.

regional_presence.Taiwan: LINTEC has a presence in Taiwan, focusing on the semiconductor manufacturing sector.
